scope: static, AI-assisted, nothing executed; production code read, tests skimmed; tripwire, overlap and apply-vs-main triage used
findings: Adds opt-in LEONIDA_COMPAT_DIR: when set, an imported DLL that exists as a file in that folder is loaded by full path with LoadLibraryExW (SEARCH_DLL_LOAD_DIR | SEARCH_SYSTEM32, never the game folder) and its exports serve the import; README and 114-line test added.

Risky-but-opt-in feature: it executes whatever DLL the user places in the folder named by an environment variable (host code, DllMain runs). Mitigations present: full path, no separators/colon in the key, regular-file check, load failure throws. Tripwire (LoadLibraryExW) confirmed as this intended load, not a bare-name load.
Read the C++ diff. No overlap, applies cleanly. Maintainer should decide whether executing user-supplied host DLLs is in scope.
